SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%' THEN "p".score ELSE 0 END) AS "germany_last_editor_posts_total_score", SUM(CASE WHEN "u".id IS NULL OR "u".location IS NULL OR "u".location NOT ILIKE '%Germany%' THEN "p".score ELSE 0 END) AS "other_posts_total_score", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%' THEN "u".id END) AS "germany_last_editor_user_count", (SELECT SUM(reputation) FROM "users" WHERE id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "p2".lasteditoruserid FROM "posts" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u2" ON "p2".lasteditoruserid = "u2".id WHERE "p2"."creaiondate" >= '2012-01-01' AND "p2"."creaiondate" < '2013-01-01' AND "u2".location ILIKE '%Germany%')) AS "germany_users_combined_reputation" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "p".lasteditoruserid = "u".id WHERE "p"."creaiondate" >= '2012-01-01' AND "p"."creaiondate" < '2013-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT SUM("u".reputation) FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".owneruserid WHERE "p".score = 10 AND "p".tags ~ '(^|<)r(>|$)' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("u".reputation) AS "combined_reputation" FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".owneruserid WHERE "p".tags LIKE '%<r>%' AND "p".lasactivitydate >= '2014-08-27 00:00:00+00' AND "p".lasactivitydate < '2014-08-28 00:00:00+00' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("linking".score) AS "total_score" FROM "postlinks" AS "l" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "target" ON "target".id = "l".relatedpostid INNER JOIN "posts" AS "linking" ON "linking".id = "l".postid WHERE "target".title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?' AND "linking".tags ILIKE '%<r>%' LIMIT 501

WITH "user_badge_totals" AS (SELECT "u".id, "u".displayname, COUNT("b".id) AS "badge_total" FROM "users" AS "u" LEFT JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "b".userid = "u".id WHERE "u".location = 'Germany' GROUP BY "u".id, "u".displayname), "ranked_totals" AS (SELECT badge_total, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY badge_total DESC) AS "total_rank" FROM "user_badge_totals") SELECT "ubt".displayname, "ubt".badge_total FROM "user_badge_totals" AS "ubt" WHERE "ubt".badge_total = (SELECT MAX("ubt2".badge_total) FROM "user_badge_totals" AS "ubt2" WHERE "ubt2".badge_total < (SELECT MAX(badge_total) FROM "user_badge_totals")) ORDER BY "ubt".displayname ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT age FROM "users" WHERE location IN ('York', 'York, United Kingdom') AND reputation = (SELECT MAX(reputation) FROM "users" WHERE location IN ('York', 'York, United Kingdom')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "u".id) FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "b".userid = "u".id WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%India%' AND "b".name = 'Yearling' AND "b".date < '2014-01-01'::TIMESTAMPTZ LIMIT 501

WITH "matching_posts" AS (SELECT id, title FROM "posts" WHERE title ILIKE '%principal component scores%'), "related_counts" AS (SELECT "mp".id, "mp".title, COUNT("pl".id) AS "related_post_count" FROM "matching_posts" AS "mp" LEFT JOIN "postlinks" AS "pl" ON "pl".postid = "mp".id OR "pl".relatedpostid = "mp".id GROUP BY "mp".id, "mp".title), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, title, related_post_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY related_post_count DESC) AS "rank" FROM "related_counts") SELECT title, related_post_count FROM "ranked" WHERE rank = 1 LIMIT 501
SELECT id FROM "users" WHERE displayname = 'Michael' AND age IS NOT NULL ORDER BY age ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".owneruserid IS NOT NULL THEN 'id:' || "p".owneruserid::TEXT ELSE 'name:' || "p".ownerdisplayname END) AS "user_count" FROM "votes" AS "v" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "v".postid WHERE "v".bountyamount >= 30 AND "v".creationdate >= DATE '2010-01-01' AND "v".creationdate < DATE '2011-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".reputation)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE creaiondate >= '2010-01-01'::TIMESTAMPTZ AND creaiondate < '2011-01-01'::TIMESTAMPTZ) AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "u".location = 'India' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("v".upvotes_cast, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_upvotes_cast", ROUND(AVG("u".age)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_age" FROM (SELECT "p".owneruserid AS "userid" FROM "posts" AS "p" WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2013-01-01' AND "p".owneruserid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".owneruserid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) AS "prolific" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "prolific".userid LEFT JOIN (SELECT "votes".userid, COUNT(*) AS "upvotes_cast" FROM "votes" WHERE "votes".votetypeid = 2 GROUP BY "votes".userid) AS "v" ON "v".userid = "prolific".userid LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(month_count), 2) AS "average_monthly_posts" FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".postid) AS "month_count" FROM "postlinks" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pl".postid WHERE "pl".creationdate >= '2010-01-01' AND "pl".creationdate < '2010-02-01' AND "p".answercount <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".postid) FROM "postlinks" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pl".postid WHERE "pl".creationdate >= '2010-02-01' AND "pl".creationdate < '2010-03-01' AND "p".answercount <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".postid) FROM "postlinks" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pl".postid WHERE "pl".creationdate >= '2010-03-01' AND "pl".creationdate < '2010-04-01' AND "p".answercount <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".postid) FROM "postlinks" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pl".postid WHERE "pl".creationdate >= '2010-04-01' AND "pl".creationdate < '2010-05-01' AND "p".answercount <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".postid) FROM "postlinks" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pl".postid WHERE "pl".creationdate >= '2010-05-01' AND "pl".creationdate < '2010-06-01' AND "p".answercount <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".postid) FROM "postlinks" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pl".postid WHERE "pl".creationdate >= '2010-06-01' AND "pl".creationdate < '2010-07-01' AND "p".answercount <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".postid) FROM "postlinks" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pl".postid WHERE "pl".creationdate >= '2010-07-01' AND "pl".creationdate < '2010-08-01' AND "p".answercount <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "pl".postid) FROM "postlinks" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pl".postid WHERE "pl".creationdate >= '2010-08-01' AND "pl".creationdate < '2010-09-01' AND "p".answercount <= 2) AS "month_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "u".reputation < 1000 OR "u".reputation IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".owneruserid WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2011-01-01' AND "p".score > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT "u".displayname, COUNT(*) AS "edit_comment_count" FROM "posthistory" AS "ph" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "ph".postid LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "ph".userid WHERE "p".title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?' AND "ph".posthistorytypeid IN (4, 5) AND "ph".comment IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("ph".comment) <> '' GROUP BY "ph".userid, "u".displayname HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(editor_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "editor_count" FROM "posthistory" AS "ph2" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "ph2".postid WHERE "p2".title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?' AND "ph2".posthistorytypeid IN (4, 5) AND "ph2".comment IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("ph2".comment) <> '' GROUP BY "ph2".userid) AS "editor_counts") ORDER BY "u".displayname ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, "y".customerid, SUM("y".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date <= '201312' GROUP BY "c".segment, "y".customerid), "winners" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (segment) segment, customerid, total_consumption FROM "totals" ORDER BY segment ASC, total_consumption ASC, customerid ASC), "selected" AS (SELECT MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') AS "sme", MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS "lam", MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS "kam" FROM "winners") SELECT ROUND((sme - lam)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "SME minus LAM", ROUND((lam - kam)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "LAM minus KAM", ROUND((kam - sme)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "KAM minus SME" FROM "selected" LIMIT 501

WITH "segment_totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301') AS "total_2012", SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401') AS "total_2013" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') GROUP BY "c".segment), "increases" AS (SELECT segment, (total_2013 - total_2012) * 100.0 / total_2012 AS "increase_percentage" FROM "segment_totals") SELECT segment, ROUND(increase_percentage::NUMERIC, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "increases" WHERE increase_percentage = (SELECT MAX(increase_percentage) FROM "increases") OR increase_percentage = (SELECT MIN(increase_percentage) FROM "increases") ORDER BY increase_percentage DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_customer" AS (SELECT DISTINCT customerid FROM "transactions_1k" WHERE date = DATE '2012-08-25' AND price::NUMERIC = 634.8), "annual_totals" AS (SELECT "y".customerid, SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301') AS "total_2012", SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401') AS "total_2013" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "target_customer" AS "t" ON "t".customerid = "y".customerid GROUP BY "y".customerid) SELECT ROUND(((total_2013 - total_2012) / total_2012)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "relative_change" FROM "annual_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".customerid) AS "count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y12" ON "y12".customerid = "c".customerid INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y13" ON "y13".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "y12".date >= '201201' AND "y12".date <= '201212' AND "y13".date >= '201301' AND "y13".date <= '201312' LIMIT 501

WITH "annual_consumption" AS (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE "date" >= '201201' AND "date" < '201301' GROUP BY customerid), "active_2012" AS (SELECT DISTINCT customerid FROM "transactions_1k" WHERE "date" >= DATE '2012-01-01' AND "date" < DATE '2013-01-01') SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "annual_consumption" AS "a" INNER JOIN "active_2012" AS "t" ON "t".customerid = "a".customerid INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "a".customerid WHERE "a".total_consumption < 30000 GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".customerid) AS "customers_who_consumed_fuel" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE LEFT("y".date, 4) = '2013' AND "y".consumption > 0 GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

SELECT FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX("t"."date" + "t"."time"::TIME) - MIN("t"."date" + "t"."time"::TIME))) / 60)::BIGINT AS "elapsed_whole_minutes" FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "gasstations" AS "g" ON "t".gasstationid = "g".gasstationid WHERE "g".country = 'CZE' AND "t".price > 1000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".currency, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN (SELECT customerid FROM "yearmonth" WHERE date >= '201301' AND date <= '201311' AND consumption > 0 GROUP BY customerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT date) = 11) AS "active" ON "active".customerid = "c".customerid GROUP BY "c".currency LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "c".currency = 'EUR' THEN "q".quarter_consumption END)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "eur_average", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "c".currency = 'CZK' THEN "q".quarter_consumption END)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "czk_average" FROM (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS "quarter_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE "date" >= '201304' AND "date" < '201307' GROUP BY customerid) AS "q" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "q".customerid LIMIT 501

WITH "monthly_totals" AS (SELECT LEFT("date", 4) AS "year", "date", SUM(consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE "date" >= '201201' AND "date" < '201401' GROUP BY LEFT("date", 4), "date"), "yearly_peaks" AS (SELECT year, MAX(total_consumption) AS "peak_total" FROM "monthly_totals" GROUP BY year) SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN peak_total END)::NUMERIC - MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN peak_total END)::NUMERIC) AS "difference" FROM "yearly_peaks" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(customer_average) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'CZK') - AVG(customer_average) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR')) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT "c".customerid, "c".currency, AVG("y".consumption) AS "customer_average" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301' GROUP BY "c".customerid, "c".currency) AS "customer_averages" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM (SELECT "c".customerid FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'KAM' AND "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' GROUP BY "c".customerid HAVING SUM("y".consumption) > 1000000) AS "qualifying_customers" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".customerid) FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "t".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'SME' AND "t".date >= DATE '2013-02-01' AND "t".date < DATE '2013-03-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_long_name FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l" ON "m".league_id = "l".id INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "m".away_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id WHERE "l".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m".season = '2009/2010' AND "m".away_team_goal > "m".home_team_goal GROUP BY "t".team_long_name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(away_wins) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "away_wins" FROM "match" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l2" ON "m2".league_id = "l2".id WHERE "l2".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m2".season = '2009/2010' AND "m2".away_team_goal > "m2".home_team_goal GROUP BY "m2".away_team_api_id) AS "wins_by_team") ORDER BY "t".team_long_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "t".team_long_name FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "ta".team_api_id WHERE "ta".date >= '2012-01-01' AND "ta".date < '2013-01-01' AND "ta".buildupplaypassing > (SELECT AVG("ta2".buildupplaypassing) FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta2" WHERE "ta2".date >= '2012-01-01' AND "ta2".date < '2013-01-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name, "p".player_api_id, AVG("pa".heading_accuracy) AS "mean_heading_accuracy" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height > 180 AND "pa".heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".player_api_id, "p".player_name ORDER BY mean_heading_accuracy DESC, "p".player_api_id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT "l".name FROM "league" AS "l" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".league_id = "l".id WHERE "m".season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY "l".id, "l".name HAVING AVG("m".home_team_goal) > AVG("m".away_team_goal) LIMIT 501

WITH "extreme_players" AS (SELECT player_api_id, player_name, height, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS "tallest_rank", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height ASC) AS "shortest_rank" FROM "player" WHERE height IS NOT NULL), "candidates" AS (SELECT player_api_id, player_name, height FROM "extreme_players" WHERE tallest_rank = 1 OR shortest_rank = 1), "averages" AS (SELECT "c".player_api_id, "c".player_name, "c".height, AVG("pa".finishing) AS "avg_finishing" FROM "candidates" AS "c" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "c".player_api_id WHERE "pa".finishing IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "c".player_api_id, "c".player_name, "c".height) SELECT player_name FROM "averages" ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN "p".player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN "pa".ball_control END) - AVG(CASE WHEN "p".player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN "pa".ball_control END) AS "mean_ball_control_difference" FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye') AND "pa".ball_control IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT "p".player_name, "pa".overall_rating, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "p".player_api_id ORDER BY "pa".date DESC, "pa".id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN overall_rating END) - MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END), 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM "latest" WHERE rn = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "pa".date FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name = 'Kevin Constant' AND "pa".crossing = (SELECT MAX("pa2".crossing) FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa2" WHERE "pa2".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id) ORDER BY "pa".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "m".home_player_3 WHERE "p".height > 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".a2 AS "district", ROUND((("d".a16 - "d".a15)::NUMERIC / NULLIF("d".a15, 0)) * 100, 2) AS "percentage_change" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "l".status = 'D' AND "d".a15 IS NOT NULL AND "d".a16 IS NOT NULL AND "d".a15 <> 0 ORDER BY "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "x" ON "x".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".type <> 'OWNER' AND "x".a12 > 8000 AND "x".a12 <= 9000 GROUP BY "d".type LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) = 1997 THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) = 1996 THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) = 1996 THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "percentage_growth" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "l".account_id = "d".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "d".client_id = "c".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".account_id = 3 AND "o".amount = 3539 LIMIT 501

WITH "first_month" AS (SELECT MIN(date) AS "first_date" FROM "account"), "opened_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" CROSS JOIN "first_month" AS "f" WHERE "a".date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', "f".first_date)::DATE AND "a".date < (DATE_TRUNC('month', "f".first_date) + INTERVAL '1 month')::DATE), "district_populations" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "opened_districts" AS "od" ON "od".district_id = "d".district_id) SELECT district_id, population FROM "district_populations" WHERE population = (SELECT MAX(population) FROM "district_populations") ORDER BY district_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id IN (SELECT "dp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "dp".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') AND "t".k_symbol IS NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "top_districts" AS (SELECT district_id, a2 FROM "district" ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC LIMIT 5), "district_accounts" AS (SELECT "td".district_id, "td".a2, "a".account_id FROM "top_districts" AS "td" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "td".district_id), "district_totals" AS (SELECT "da".district_id, "da".a2, COUNT(DISTINCT "da".account_id) AS "account_count", COALESCE(SUM("l".amount) FILTER (WHERE "l".status IN ('C', 'D')), 0) AS "active_loan_amount" FROM "district_accounts" AS "da" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "da".account_id GROUP BY "da".district_id, "da".a2), "ranked" AS (SELECT a2 AS "district_name", ROUND(active_loan_amount::NUMERIC / account_count) AS "average_active_loan_per_account", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY active_loan_amount::NUMERIC / account_count DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "district_totals") SELECT district_name, average_active_loan_per_account FROM "ranked" WHERE rnk = 1 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".amount, "d".a3 AS "region" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date + ("l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month') > DATE '1995-12-31'), "totals" AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY region) SELECT region, total_amount FROM "totals" WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM "totals") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(district_avg_salary), 2) AS "average_district_avg_salary", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, AVG("d".a11) AS "district_avg_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id) AS "eligible_districts" LIMIT 501

WITH "target_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id, "d".a11::NUMERIC AS "avg_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "disp" AS "any_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "any_disp".disp_id WHERE "any_disp".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id)) SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS "average_of_district_average_salaries" FROM "target_districts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "dp".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "eligible_accounts" LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "eligible_accounts".account_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".trans_id) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(DISTINCT "t".trans_id) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01' AND "t".amount > 4000 LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opening_date", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".date), "owners" AS (SELECT "d".account_id, "c".district_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER'), "counterparties" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".account) AS "counterparty_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".account_id) SELECT "b".account_id, "b".opening_date, "b".total_borrowed, COALESCE("cp".counterparty_count, 0) AS "outside_counterparty_count", "home".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "home".a8 AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "home".a8 DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "borrowing" AS "b" INNER JOIN "owners" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "b".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "o".district_id LEFT JOIN "counterparties" AS "cp" ON "cp".account_id = "b".account_id ORDER BY "home".a8 DESC, "b".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_avg" AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS "avg_balance" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "qa" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "a".district_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "cd".client_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "od" ON "od".account_id = "cd".account_id AND "od".client_id = "cd".client_id AND "od".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "cd".account_id INNER JOIN "account_avg" AS "aa" ON "aa".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "aa".avg_balance > 1000) SELECT "qa".gender, COUNT(DISTINCT "qa".district_id) AS "district_count", "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a8 AS "inhabitants", round(AVG("d".a12)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", round(AVG("d".a13)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_urban_ratio" FROM "qa" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "qa".district_id WHERE "d".a8 > 100000 GROUP BY "qa".gender, "d".a2, "d".a8 ORDER BY CASE "qa".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payment_count, total_amount_paid FROM (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("t".amount) DESC) AS "payment_rank" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "dp".disp_id AND "c".type = 'gold' WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "d".a4::BIGINT >= 250000 AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account) AS "ranked" WHERE payment_rank = 1 ORDER BY bank ASC, account ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "dp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "dp".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id), "eligible_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id, "d".a3, "d".a2, "d".a8, "d".a10, "d".a13 FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" ON "qa".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "ranked_districts" AS (SELECT a3, a2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a8 DESC, a2 ASC) AS "rn" FROM "eligible_districts") SELECT "ed".a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG("ed".a10)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("ed".a13)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_unemployment_rate", MAX("rd".a2) FILTER (WHERE "rd".rn = 1) AS "most_populous_district" FROM "eligible_districts" AS "ed" INNER JOIN "ranked_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".a3 = "ed".a3 AND "rd".a2 = "ed".a2 GROUP BY "ed".a3 ORDER BY "ed".a3 ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "type_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c"."type" AS "card_type", "cl".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "c".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id) SELECT "td".card_type, "td".district_name, "td".inhabitants FROM "type_districts" AS "td" WHERE "td".card_type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior') AND "td".inhabitants = (SELECT MIN("td2".inhabitants) FROM "type_districts" AS "td2" WHERE "td2".card_type = "td".card_type) ORDER BY CASE "td".card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, "td".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), "opened" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "region") AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "last_transaction" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("t".account_id) "t".account_id, "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "opened" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY "t".account_id ASC, "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC), "account_balances" AS (SELECT "o".district_id, "lt".balance FROM "opened" AS "o" INNER JOIN "last_transaction" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "o".account_id), "district_stats" AS (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", AVG("ab".balance)::NUMERIC AS "avg_balance" FROM "account_balances" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ab".district_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2) SELECT district_name FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "top_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".amount, "d".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10), "district_set" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "yearly_salary" FROM "top_loans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "t".district_id), "most_populous" AS (SELECT district_id, inhabitants FROM "district_set" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "mp".district_id, "mp".inhabitants, ROUND(AVG("ds".yearly_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "most_populous" AS "mp" CROSS JOIN "district_set" AS "ds" GROUP BY "mp".district_id, "mp".inhabitants LIMIT 501

WITH "district_withdrawals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id), "district_accounts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "account" GROUP BY district_id), "district_orders" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("o".amount::NUMERIC) AS "total_standing_order_debit" FROM "order" AS "o" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "o".account_id GROUP BY "a".district_id), "metrics" AS (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "dw".total_withdrawn, "dw".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / NULLIF("d".a4::NUMERIC, 0) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", COALESCE("do".total_standing_order_debit, 0)::NUMERIC / "da".account_count AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "district_withdrawals" AS "dw" ON "dw".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "district_accounts" AS "da" ON "da".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "district_orders" AS "do" ON "do".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000) SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS "rank", ROUND(average_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "metrics" ORDER BY rank ASC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "client_home" AS (SELECT "c".client_id, "c".district_id AS "home_district_id" FROM "client" AS "c" WHERE "c".client_id = 3541), "accessible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client_home" AS "ch" ON "ch".client_id = "d".client_id), "tx" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "ranked_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "population_rank", FIRST_VALUE("d".a2) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "most_populous_district_name", FIRST_VALUE("d".a4::BIGINT) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "most_populous_inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d"), "region_client_counts" AS (SELECT "hd".a3, COUNT(*) AS "home_client_count" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "hd" ON "hd".district_id = "c".district_id GROUP BY "hd".a3) SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "account_opened_date", "a".frequency, "ad".a2 AS "district_name", "ad".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "ad".district_id = "ch".home_district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_client_home_district", "ad".a10 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("tx".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("tx".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("tx".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("tx".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "rcc".home_client_count AS "clients_in_region", "rd".most_populous_district_name, "rd".most_populous_inhabitants, "rd".population_rank AS "account_district_population_rank" FROM "accessible" AS "ac" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "ac".account_id INNER JOIN "client_home" AS "ch" ON TRUE INNER JOIN "district" AS "ad" ON "ad".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "ranked_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".district_id = "ad".district_id INNER JOIN "region_client_counts" AS "rcc" ON "rcc".a3 = "ad".a3 LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "tx" ON "tx".account_id = "a".account_id ORDER BY COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_loans" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)::INTEGER AS "account_year", district_id, SUM(amount_lent)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "lent_per_account" FROM "account_loans" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date), district_id), "year_totals" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)::INTEGER AS "account_year", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent" FROM "account_loans" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)) SELECT "yt".account_year::TEXT AS "account_year", "yt".accounts_opened, "yt".total_amount_lent, ROUND(AVG("dy".lent_per_account), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "year_totals" AS "yt" INNER JOIN "district_year" AS "dy" ON "dy".account_year = "yt".account_year GROUP BY "yt".account_year, "yt".accounts_opened, "yt".total_amount_lent ORDER BY "yt".account_year ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".date, "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 10), "closing_balance" AS (SELECT "r".loan_id, "t".balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "r".loan_id ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "r".account_id AND "t".date <= "r".date) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "r".amount AS "approved_amount", "r".date AS "approval_date", "cb".balance AS "account_balance" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "r".district_id LEFT JOIN "closing_balance" AS "cb" ON "cb".loan_id = "r".loan_id AND "cb".rn = 1 ORDER BY "r".amount DESC, "r".date ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_cards" AS (SELECT "ca".card_id, "dp".client_id, "dp".account_id, "ca".type AS "card_type", "ca".issued FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01'), "client_profile" AS (SELECT "tc".card_id, "tc".client_id, "tc".account_id, "tc".card_type, "tc".issued, "cl".gender, "cl".birth_date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "tc".issued)::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "cl".birth_date)::INT AS "age_at_issue", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a13 AS "district_average_salary" FROM "target_cards" AS "tc" INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "tc".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id), "loans_by_account" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id), "profile" AS (SELECT cp.*, COALESCE("lba".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("lba".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "client_profile" AS "cp" LEFT JOIN "loans_by_account" AS "lba" ON "lba".account_id = "cp".account_id) SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, card_type, age_at_issue, number_of_loans, total_amount_borrowed, CASE WHEN number_of_loans > 0 AND age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN number_of_loans > 0 AND age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", district_name, district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "profile" ORDER BY client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol IS NULL GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".amount = 98832 AND "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".account_id) FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = (SELECT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" WHERE "d".client_id = 2823 LIMIT 1) AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration > 24 AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a8 FROM "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "qa".district_id), "region_totals" AS (SELECT "qd".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "qualifying_district_count", SUM("qd".a8) AS "combined_population", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa2" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "qa2".district_id WHERE "d2".a3 = "qd".a3) AS "total_accounts" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "qd" GROUP BY "qd".a3) SELECT region, qualifying_district_count, combined_population, total_accounts FROM "region_totals" ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "monthly_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" WHERE "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01'), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a11 FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "monthly_accounts" AS "ma" ON "ma".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a11) SELECT COUNT("ma".account_id) AS "total_monthly_statement_accounts", COUNT(DISTINCT "q".district_id) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("q".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "q" INNER JOIN "monthly_accounts" AS "ma" ON "ma".district_id = "q".district_id LIMIT 501

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".disp_id = "c".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "transaction_totals" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_amount_received", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ') AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 AND "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')) AS "external_counterparty_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "loan_totals" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".account_id), "account_results" AS (SELECT "ga".account_id, "di".a2 AS "district_name", "di".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("lt".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", COALESCE("tt".external_counterparty_count, 0) AS "external_counterparty_count" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "ga" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "ga".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "di" ON "di".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_totals" AS "tt" ON "tt".account_id = "ga".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan_totals" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "ga".account_id) SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_amount_received, total_amount_withdrawn, loan_count, external_counterparty_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparty_count DESC) AS "rank" FROM "account_results" ORDER BY external_counterparty_count DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id, "a".account_id, "dp".client_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "dp".disp_id AND "c".type = 'classic'), "client_counts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS "client_count" FROM "eligible_accounts" GROUP BY district_id), "payment_stats" AS (SELECT "e".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) AS "external_accounts", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "eligible_accounts" AS "e" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "e".account_id AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".district_id) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COALESCE("cc".client_count, 0) AS "client_count", COALESCE("ps".external_accounts, 0) AS "external_accounts", COALESCE("ps".total_amount, 0) AS "total_amount" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "client_counts" AS "cc" ON "cc".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "payment_stats" AS "ps" ON "ps".district_id = "d".district_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".positiontext <> '1') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage_not_victories" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Lewis' AND "d".surname = 'Hamilton' AND "ra".year >= 2010 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "dr".laps = "winner".laps) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "dr" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "dr".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "dr".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "dr".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 WHERE "d".nationality = 'Japanese' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND "res".laps > 50) / COUNT(*) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "res".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("res".points) AS "score", "c".name, "c".nationality FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "res".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "r".name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".nationality ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2008 AND "c".name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' ORDER BY "q".q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 1995 AND "r2".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q1) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND "q".q2 = '1:35.396' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND "q".q2 < '1:40.000' LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, CASE WHEN "eligible".driverid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ("eligible".fastest_ms / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || CASE WHEN ("eligible".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || (("eligible".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000)::TEXT || '.' || CASE WHEN "eligible".fastest_ms % 1000 < 10 THEN '00' WHEN "eligible".fastest_ms % 1000 < 100 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || ("eligible".fastest_ms % 1000)::TEXT END AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "lt".driverid, MIN("lt".milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "laptimes" AS "lt" WHERE "lt".raceid = "r".raceid GROUP BY "lt".driverid HAVING MIN("lt".milliseconds) > 90000) AS "eligible" ON TRUE LEFT JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "eligible".driverid WHERE "r".year >= 1990 AND "c".name = 'Circuit de Nevers Magny-Cours' ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "d".surname ASC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name", "ra".name AS "race_name", "ra".year AS "race_year", "q".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "d".dob) > 1980 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER = 1 AND SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2), '.', 1)::INTEGER = 4 AND SPLIT_PART("q".q3, '.', 2)::INTEGER = 424 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' AND "r".fastestlap IS NOT NULL AND "r".rank = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "season_totals" AS (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "r".year, MAX("cs".points) AS "season_points" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid GROUP BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year), "career_totals" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("st".season_points), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "season_totals" AS "st" ON "st".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url), "ranked" AS (SELECT name, career_points, url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "rank" FROM "career_totals") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "res".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename ORDER BY "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM("q".q3), '') IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM("q2".q3), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "con".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "r".rank = 1 THEN "con".constructorid END) AS "constructors_with_fastest_lap" FROM "constructors" AS "con" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "con".constructorid GROUP BY "con".nationality ORDER BY "con".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, COUNT("p".raceid) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "eligible".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2) ~ '^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+$' AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) > 120 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "p2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p2".milliseconds IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

WITH "winning_drivers" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "res".position = 1 AND "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017), "oldest_winner" AS (SELECT driverid, forename, surname, nationality FROM "winning_drivers" ORDER BY dob ASC, forename ASC, surname ASC LIMIT 1), "first_win" AS (SELECT "r".name, "r".date FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "oldest_winner" AS "ow" ON "ow".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "res".position = 1 AND "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "r".name ASC LIMIT 1), "career_starts" AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".raceid) AS "total_starts" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "oldest_winner" AS "ow" ON "ow".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017) SELECT "ow".forename || ' ' || "ow".surname AS "full_name", "ow".nationality, "fw".name AS "first_race_won", "fw".date AS "first_win_date", "cs".total_starts FROM "oldest_winner" AS "ow" CROSS JOIN "first_win" AS "fw" CROSS JOIN "career_starts" AS "cs" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '' ORDER BY "q".q2 ASC, "q".position ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2_time) FROM (SELECT q2 AS "q2_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q2q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "q2r" ON "q2r".raceid = "q2q".raceid WHERE "q2r".year = 2017 AND "q2q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2q".q2) <> '') AS "season_q2_times") LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN(BTRIM("q2".q3)) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN(BTRIM("q2".q3)) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year AS "season_year", ("runner_up".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds) AS "runner_up_time_gap_milliseconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 INNER JOIN "results" AS "runner_up" ON "runner_up".raceid = "r".raceid AND "runner_up".position = 2 WHERE "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time = (SELECT MIN("r2".time) FROM "races" AS "r2" WHERE "r2".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r2".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "r2".time IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY "r".year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "d".code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time::TIME <= TIME '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 < '1:38.000' LIMIT 501

WITH "timed_races" AS (SELECT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL), "extremes" AS (SELECT MIN(start_time) AS "earliest_time", MAX(start_time) AS "latest_time" FROM "timed_races"), "names" AS (SELECT (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "tr".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "tr".circuitref ASC) FROM "timed_races" AS "tr" CROSS JOIN "extremes" AS "e" WHERE "tr".start_time = "e".earliest_time) AS "earliest_circuitref", (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "tr".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "tr".circuitref ASC) FROM "timed_races" AS "tr" CROSS JOIN "extremes" AS "e" WHERE "tr".start_time = "e".latest_time) AS "latest_circuitref", earliest_time, latest_time FROM "extremes") SELECT earliest_circuitref, latest_circuitref, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (latest_time - earliest_time)) AS "gap_seconds" FROM "names" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1991-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND btrim("r".fastestlapspeed) <> '' ORDER BY CAST("r".fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND ("q".q2 IS NULL OR BTRIM("q".q2) = '') ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "r".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "r".statusid = "s".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".position IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "ra".year = 1957 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_expense_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "event_expense_total" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "x".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND "x".expense_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "x".expense_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "e".event_date::DATE) = 2019 THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "e".event_date::DATE) = 2020 THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "difference" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "e".event_date::DATE) IN (2019, 2020) LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT "y".amount::NUMERIC / NULLIF("o".amount::NUMERIC, 0) AS "ratio" FROM (SELECT "b".amount FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' AND "b".category = 'Advertisement') AS "y" CROSS JOIN (SELECT "b".amount FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "b".category = 'Advertisement' AND "e".event_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-11-01') AS "o" LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, SUM("b".spent) AS "total_spending", SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budget_amount" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "ratios" AS (SELECT event_id, event_name, total_spending::NUMERIC / NULLIF(total_budget_amount, 0) AS "ratio" FROM "event_totals") SELECT event_name FROM "ratios" WHERE ratio = (SELECT MAX(ratio) FROM "ratios") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "name" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

SELECT "result".attendance, "result".fall_2019_average, CASE WHEN "result".attendance > "result".fall_2019_average THEN 'more' WHEN "result".attendance < "result".fall_2019_average THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM (SELECT (SELECT COUNT("a".link_to_member) FROM "event" AS "w" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "w".event_id WHERE "w".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "attendance", (SELECT ROUND(AVG("c".head_count)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "head_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "c") AS "fall_2019_average") AS "result" LIMIT 501

SELECT "m"."department", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "m"."major_name", ', ' ORDER BY "m"."major_name" ASC) AS "majors_offered", COALESCE(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "mb"."member_id" IS NOT NULL THEN "m"."major_name" END, ', ' ORDER BY CASE WHEN "mb"."member_id" IS NOT NULL THEN "m"."major_name" END ASC), '') AS "majors_held_by_members", ROUND(COUNT("mb"."member_id")::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "m"."major_id"), 0), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "major" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mb" ON "mb"."link_to_major" = "m"."major_id" WHERE "m"."department" IN (SELECT DISTINCT "m2"."department" FROM "major" AS "m2" WHERE "m2"."college" = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') GROUP BY "m"."department" ORDER BY "m"."department" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_type", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended", COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event, amount FROM "budget") AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "dep".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Engineering') AS "dep" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "maj" ON "maj".department = "dep".department LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".link_to_major = "maj".major_id AND "mem".position = 'Member' LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "mem".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "mem".member_id IS NULL OR "mem".member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM "attendance") GROUP BY "dep".department ORDER BY "dep".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - "b".spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left_dollars" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "e".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left_dollars DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dollars" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' AND "e".event_name ILIKE '%Football game%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_name) FROM "major" AS "m" WHERE "m".college = (SELECT DISTINCT "tmajor".college FROM "member" AS "tm" INNER JOIN "major" AS "tmajor" ON "tm".link_to_major = "tmajor".major_id WHERE "tm".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "tm".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "enrolled" WHERE "enrolled".link_to_major = "m".major_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(AVG(attendance_count), 'FM999999990.00') AS "average_attendees_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendance_count" FROM "budget" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event WHERE "b".category ILIKE 'Advertisement' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "mj".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "major" AS "mj" ON "m".link_to_major = "mj".major_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "mj".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) = (SELECT MAX("c".attendee_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".member_id) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "a2".link_to_member = "m2".member_id INNER JOIN "major" AS "mj2" ON "m2".link_to_major = "mj2".major_id WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "mj2".major_name) AS "c") ORDER BY "mj".major_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "m" WHERE "m".link_to_major = "maj".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" AS "maj" LIMIT 501

WITH "attendance_counts" AS (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) AS "events_attended" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) SELECT ROUND(AVG(events_attended) FILTER (WHERE position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_events_attended_per_officer", ROUND(AVG(events_attended) FILTER (WHERE position NOT IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_events_attended_per_other_student" FROM "attendance_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(split_part("e".expense_description, ',', "u".n))) FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "ev" ON "ev".event_id = "b".link_to_event CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) AS "u" WHERE "b".amount - "b".spent < 0 AND "ev".event_date >= (SELECT MIN(event_date) FROM "event") AND "ev".event_date <= (SELECT MAX(event_date) FROM "event") AND split_part("e".expense_description, ',', "u".n) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_cost, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count, 2) AS "amount_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "water_cost" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE 'Water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "major".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 'major in College of Humanities and Social Sciences' ELSE 'do not major in College of Humanities and Social Sciences' END AS "group_name", COUNT(*) AS "member_count" FROM "member" LEFT JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN "major".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 'major in College of Humanities and Social Sciences' ELSE 'do not major in College of Humanities and Social Sciences' END ORDER BY group_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "chip_events" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b".link_to_event FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description IN ('Water, chips, cookies', 'Water, cookies, chips')), "event_max" AS (SELECT "c".link_to_event, MAX("b".amount) AS "largest_line" FROM "chip_events" AS "c" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "c".link_to_event GROUP BY "c".link_to_event), "ranked" AS (SELECT link_to_event, largest_line, MAX(largest_line) OVER () AS "overall_max" FROM "event_max") SELECT DISTINCT "e".event_name FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "r".link_to_event WHERE "r".largest_line = "r".overall_max LIMIT 501

SELECT MAX("e".expense_date) AS "expense_date", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" WHERE "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("e2".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "e2".link_to_member WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "college_counts" AS (SELECT "major".college, COUNT(DISTINCT "major".major_id) AS "major_count" FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id GROUP BY "major".college), "ranked" AS (SELECT college, major_count, MAX(major_count) OVER () AS "top_count" FROM "college_counts") SELECT college, major_count FROM "ranked" WHERE major_count = top_count ORDER BY college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "number_of_different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 AND "e".location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_amount_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "bx".link_to_event FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "bx" ON "bx".budget_id = "x".link_to_budget WHERE "x".expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "pizza_events" ON "pizza_events".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(AVG(event_spent), 'FM999999999999990.00') AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "event_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budget", COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spending" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "eligible" AS (SELECT * FROM "event_totals" WHERE total_spending <= total_budget), "purchase_counts" AS (SELECT "el".event_id, "el".event_name, COUNT("x".expense_id) AS "purchases" FROM "eligible" AS "el" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "el".event_id LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "el".event_id, "el".event_name) SELECT event_name FROM "purchase_counts" ORDER BY purchases DESC, event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "counts" AS (SELECT "e"."type" AS "event_type", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e"."type") SELECT event_type, member_count FROM "counts" WHERE member_count = (SELECT MAX(member_count) FROM "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' AND "e".expense_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "b".category, "e".expense_description AS "item_name", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "v" ON "b".link_to_event = "v".event_id WHERE "v".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' AND "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".category, "e".expense_description ORDER BY "b".category ASC, item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE("b".total_budgeted, 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COALESCE("a".attendee_count, 0) AS "members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "expense".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "times_bought" FROM "expense" INNER JOIN "member" ON "expense".link_to_member = "member".member_id WHERE "member".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "member".last_name = 'Harrison' GROUP BY "expense".expense_description ORDER BY "expense".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "e".expense_description) AS "kind_count", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_spending" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "e".link_to_member WHERE "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY kind_count DESC LIMIT 2
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "mj".major_name) FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "mj" ON "m".link_to_major = "mj".major_id WHERE "mj".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pub" ON "pub".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT publisher_name, superhero_count, superhero_count - MIN(superhero_count) OVER () AS "difference" FROM (SELECT "p".publisher_name, COUNT("s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') GROUP BY "p".publisher_name) AS "counts" ORDER BY superhero_count DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour = 'No Colour' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501
