SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "skin".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "eye".colour IS NOT NULL AND "hair".colour IS NOT NULL AND "skin".colour IS NOT NULL AND "eye".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "hair".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "skin".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "eye".colour = "hair".colour AND "hair".colour = "skin".colour AND "p".publisher_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("p".publisher_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "skin_colour".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "gender" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin_colour" ON "superhero".skin_colour_id = "skin_colour".id WHERE "gender".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "result", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp_dc".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp_dc" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "dc" ON "dc".id = "hp_dc".hero_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc_powers" ON "dc_powers".power_id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "dc_powers".power_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "h" ON "h".id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE WHEN "h".id IN (SELECT "strength_hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "strength_hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "strength_hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AND SUM(CASE WHEN "h".id IN (SELECT "strength_hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "strength_hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "strength_hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) AS "qualifying_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

WITH "marvel_known" AS (SELECT "s".id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-'), "power_counts" AS (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "mp".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "marvel_known" AS "mp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "mp".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id GROUP BY "sp".power_name) SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM "power_counts" WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM "power_counts") ORDER BY power_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "intelligence" AS (SELECT "ha".hero_id, "ha".attribute_value FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence'), "abomination" AS (SELECT "i".attribute_value FROM "intelligence" AS "i" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".id = "i".hero_id WHERE "s".superhero_name = 'Abomination') SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "intelligence" AS "i" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".id = "i".hero_id WHERE "i".attribute_value = (SELECT attribute_value FROM "abomination") AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "gender".gender, COUNT(DISTINCT "superhero".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" INNER JOIN "superhero" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id INNER JOIN "colour" ON "colour".id = "superhero".hair_colour_id WHERE "gender".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "colour".colour = 'Blue' AND "superhero".id IN (SELECT "hero_power".hero_id FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY "hero_power".hero_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10) GROUP BY "gender".gender LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg))::INTEGER AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" WHERE id IN (SELECT "ha".hero_id FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha2".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" ON "ha2".hero_id = "h".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "h".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength')) AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL AND height_cm > 0), "tallest" AS (SELECT "s".id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "ranked" AS "r" ON "r".height_cm = "s".height_cm WHERE "r".height_rank <= 10) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "tallest" AS "t" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "t".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "abomb" ON "abomb".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' LEFT JOIN "race" AS "r_abomb" ON "r_abomb".id = "abomb".race_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "abomb".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "target".race_id WHERE "target".publisher_id = "abomb".publisher_id AND ("target".race_id IS NULL OR "r".race = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race IN ('God', 'Eternal') AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "per_hero" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1) FROM (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp2".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp2" WHERE "hp2".power_id IN (SELECT power_id FROM "hero_power" WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM "hero_power" WHERE power_id = (SELECT id FROM "superpower" WHERE power_name = 'Cryokinesis')))) GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "hero_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "dc_eye" ON "dc_eye".id = "dc".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "h".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "h".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "shared_eye" ON "shared_eye".colour = "dc_eye".colour WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "a" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".race_id = "a".race_id WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "r".race IN (SELECT "r2".race FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "s2".race_id GROUP BY "r2".race HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s2".gender_id = (SELECT id FROM "gender" WHERE gender = 'Female')) = 0) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND ("p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' OR "p".publisher_name IS NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "blackwulf" ON "blackwulf".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other_hero" ON "other_hero".eye_colour_id = "target".eye_colour_id WHERE "target".publisher_id = "blackwulf".publisher_id AND "target".eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL AND "other_hero".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "other_hero".publisher_id <> "target".publisher_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "target".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "target".full_name = 'Charles Chandler' AND "s".race_id IS NOT NULL AND "r".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r".race HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(race_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "race_count" FROM "superhero" AS "target2" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s2" ON "s2".publisher_id = "target2".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "s2".race_id WHERE "target2".full_name = 'Charles Chandler' AND "s2".race_id IS NOT NULL AND "r2".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r2".race) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND ("s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch'))) LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("p".power_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) AS "p" ON "p".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "s".full_name ~ '[[:space:]]' GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0), 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".hero_id = "target".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "shared_power" ON "shared_power".power_id = "target_power".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".id = "shared_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".id <> "target".id AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "hp".power_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' AND "p".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm > 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "lightest" AS (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS "weight_kg" FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg > 0), "counts" AS (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" CROSS JOIN "lightest" AS "l" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg = "l".weight_kg GROUP BY "s".id) SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "max_superpower_count" FROM "counts" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye_colours".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye_colours" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye_colours".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair_colours" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair_colours".id WHERE "eye_colours".colour IN (SELECT "ec".colour FROM "superhero" AS "brown_haired" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "ec" ON "brown_haired".eye_colour_id = "ec".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hc" ON "brown_haired".hair_colour_id = "hc".id WHERE "hc".colour = 'Brown') AND "hair_colours".colour <> 'Brown' GROUP BY "eye_colours".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp".power_id = "hp3".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s3" ON "s3".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s3".superhero_name = '3-D Man' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL OR "s".weight_kg = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "elevated_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id, "p".sex FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".ua IS NOT NULL AND (("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5))) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'M')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'F'), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "elevated_patients" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".alb IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age_on_2026_10_09" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".hct >= 52) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".date <= DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p"."admission" IN ('+', '+(')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01') AS "patients_with_labs" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "patients_with_labs".id LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest_rnp" AS (SELECT MAX(CAST("rnp" AS INTEGER)) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "rnp" <> 'negative'), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l"."date", "l"."id", "p"."sex", "p"."birthday" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "l"."id" CROSS JOIN "strongest_rnp" AS "s" WHERE "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' AND CAST("l"."rnp" AS INTEGER) = "s".max_rnp AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "T-BIL", "date", "id", "sex", "birthday" FROM "candidates" WHERE "T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM "candidates") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "raised" ON "raised".id = "p".id AND "raised".rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "raised".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT id, anti_rnp_titer FROM (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "anti_rnp_titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "s".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') GROUP BY "l".id) AS "patient_titers" WHERE anti_rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND id IN (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE admission = '-') AND id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ssa IS NOT NULL AND ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0'))) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "platelet_labs" ON "platelet_labs".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rnp_labs" ON "rnp_labs".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' AND "platelet_labs".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "rnp_labs".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "rnp_labs".rnp <> 'negative' AND "rnp_labs".rnp::INTEGER > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT sex, ROUND(AVG(lab_dates)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".date) AS "lab_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "e".id IS NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex) AS "patient_counts" GROUP BY sex LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id AS "patient_id", "l".date, "l".dna, "l".dna::NUMERIC AS "dna_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL), "ranked" AS (SELECT patient_id, date, dna, MAX(dna_level) OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id) AS "max_level" FROM "eligible") SELECT patient_id, date, dna FROM "ranked" WHERE dna::NUMERIC = max_level ORDER BY patient_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 16 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) AS "count" FROM "laboratory" AS "h" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "h".id WHERE "h".hct IS NOT NULL AND ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) AND "r".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "r".rnp <> 'negative' AND "r".rnp::INTEGER > 16 LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX("l"."rnp"::INTEGER) AS "highest_anti_rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

WITH "target_patients" AS (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA')), "normal_platelet_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "target_patients" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "n".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_normal_platelet", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "n".id IS NULL) AS "patients_never_with_normal_platelet" FROM "target_patients" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "normal_platelet_patients" AS "n" ON "n".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."rnp" NOT IN ('negative') AND "l"."rnp"::INTEGER > 64 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "men" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'M' AND "p".id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INT) AS "youngest_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') AND "l".date IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e"."Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "e"."Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "e".thrombosis IS NOT NULL AND "e".thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE "thrombosis" = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(examination_delay))::INTEGER AS "average_delay_days" FROM (SELECT "p".id, (MIN("e"."Examination Date") - MIN("p"."First Date")) AS "examination_delay" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."Examination Date" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id) AS "patient_delays" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id AS "patient_id", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INT AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+2(100)') ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "patient_flags" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, BOOL_OR("l".cre >= 1.5) AS "has_high_cre" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex) SELECT sex, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_high_cre) AS "patients_with_cre_at_least_1_5", COUNT(*) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_high_cre) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient_flags" GROUP BY sex ORDER BY sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "l"."T-CHO" AS "T-CHO", "p".admission AS "admission", "l".id AS "patient ID" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".admission = "p".admission AND "l2"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "patient_levels" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX(CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER)) AS "anti_rnp_level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "l".id), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, anti_rnp_level, MAX(anti_rnp_level) OVER () AS "highest_level" FROM "patient_levels") SELECT id, anti_rnp_level FROM "ranked" WHERE anti_rnp_level = highest_level LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("l".hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".hct IS NOT NULL AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "l"."U-PRO" = '+2(100)' OR "l"."U-PRO" = '+3(300)' OR "l"."U-PRO" = '4') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(')) AS "admitted_to_hospital", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission = '-') AS "followed_at_outpatient_clinic" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "p".id IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".ra IN ('-', '+-')) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_sample" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_sc170" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "latest_sample" AS "ls" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "ls".id AND "l".date = "ls".latest_date INNER JOIN "latest_sc170" AS "s" ON "s".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".id AND "r".date = "s".latest_date WHERE "ls".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "r".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ssa_patients".id) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ssa IS NOT NULL AND ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AS "ssa_patients" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0')) AS "proteinuria_patients" ON "ssa_patients".id = "proteinuria_patients".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna NOT ILIKE '%negative%' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX("l"."rnp"::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."cre" < 1.5 AND "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT id, date, rnp, rnp::INTEGER AS "rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative'), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, date, rnp, rnp_value, MAX(rnp_value) OVER () AS "max_rnp" FROM "eligible") SELECT id AS "patient identification", date AS "laboratory test date", rnp AS "anti-ribonuclear protein reading" FROM "ranked" WHERE rnp_value = max_rnp LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND (("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450) OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT(*) AS "normal_ldh_measurements" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_lab_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id AND "anemia".hgb < 10 WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex), "patient_levels" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".sex, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "e".id, "e".sex) SELECT id, sex, highest_rnp AS "highest_ever_rnp_level" FROM "patient_levels" WHERE highest_rnp = (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) FROM "patient_levels") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "first_dates" AS (SELECT id, MIN(date) AS "first_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "first_records" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".got, "l".rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date ASC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "first_dates" AS "f" ON "l".id = "f".id AND "l".date = "f".first_date) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "first_records" WHERE rn = 1 AND got < 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 10 LIMIT 501

WITH "proteinuria" AS (SELECT id, date, "U-PRO" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL), "latest" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "most_recent_date" FROM "proteinuria" GROUP BY id) SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".most_recent_date, "pr"."U-PRO" FROM "latest" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "proteinuria" AS "pr" ON "pr".id = "l".id AND "pr".date = "l".most_recent_date LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 4 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) > 0 AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER >= 16), "normal_gpt" AS (SELECT id, MAX(gpt) AS "highest_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" WHERE gpt < 60 GROUP BY id) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "eligible_patients" AS "e" INNER JOIN "normal_gpt" AS "n" ON "n".id = "e".id INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id ORDER BY "n".highest_normal_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l"."date")::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INT - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "l"."date"), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "l"."date")) < (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "p".birthday), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "p".birthday)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "age", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l"."date" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~ '(^|[,[:space:]])SLE([,[:space:]]|$)' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "patient_results" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".care_setting, BOOL_OR("l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 4) AS "has_elevated" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id, "e".care_setting) SELECT care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_elevated OR has_elevated IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "patient_results" GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "newer" WHERE "newer".id = "l".id AND "newer".date > "l".date) AND "l".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna AS "highest_anti_dna_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("l2".dna AS NUMERIC)) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l2".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l2".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_date" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_results" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "latest_date" AS "d" ON "d".id = "l".id AND "d".latest_date = "l".date WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "latest_results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id WHERE "r".rnp IN ('32', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, "l".cpk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ranked" WHERE rn = 1 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" IN ('+', '+(')) AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '-') AS "outpatient_clinic", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" IN ('+', '+(')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" IN ('+', '+(', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "ldh_lab" ON "ldh_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein_lab" ON "protein_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "ldh_lab".ldh >= 500 AND (CASE WHEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO" IN ('0', '1', '2', '3', '4', '30', '100', '300', '-15') THEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC WHEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO" = '+1(30)' THEN 30 WHEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO" = '+2(100)' THEN 100 WHEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO" = '>=1000' THEN 1000 WHEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO" = '>=300' THEN 300 ELSE NULL END) >= 100 ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "female_admitted_patients" FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission ILIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis IS NOT NULL AND "e".diagnosis ~ '(^|, )SjS(,|$)' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "ls" ON "ls".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lp" ON "lp".id = "p".id WHERE "ls".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "lp"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "abnormal_rbc" ON "abnormal_rbc".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "positive_rnp" ON "positive_rnp".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("abnormal_rbc".rbc <= 3.5 OR "abnormal_rbc".rbc >= 6.0) AND "positive_rnp".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "positive_rnp".rnp <> '0' AND "positive_rnp".rnp <> 'negative' ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday) < INTERVAL '70 years' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M'), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR("l".date, 'MMDD') < TO_CHAR("p".birthday, 'MMDD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 50 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type = '-' LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-' GROUP BY molecule_id) AS "bond_counts" INNER JOIN "molecule" USING (molecule_id) WHERE label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".element IN ('i', 's') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AND "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "p".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "p" WHERE "p".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_bonds" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, COUNT("b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label), "grouped" AS (SELECT CASE WHEN bond_count = single_bond_count THEN 'every bond is single' ELSE 'not every bond is single' END AS "group_name", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') AS "carcinogenic_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "non_carcinogenic_count" FROM "molecule_bonds" GROUP BY CASE WHEN bond_count = single_bond_count THEN 'every bond is single' ELSE 'not every bond is single' END) SELECT group_name, carcinogenic_count - non_carcinogenic_count AS "count_difference" FROM "grouped" ORDER BY CASE group_name WHEN 'every bond is single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type = '=' LIMIT 501

WITH "plus_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "participating_elements" AS (SELECT "pa".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "pa".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "plus_atoms" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "pa".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "pa".atom_id GROUP BY "pa".element), "all_atom_total" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM "plus_atoms"), "top_elements" AS (SELECT element, atom_count FROM "participating_elements" WHERE atom_count = (SELECT MAX(atom_count) FROM "participating_elements")) SELECT "te".element, ROUND("te".atom_count * 100.0 / "aat".total, 2) AS "percentage" FROM "top_elements" AS "te" CROSS JOIN "all_atom_total" AS "aat" ORDER BY "te".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ("c".atom_id, "c".atom_id2)) FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "n".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "n" WHERE "n".element = 'n' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND ("c".atom_id = "n".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "n".atom_id)) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id)) OVER (), 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "m".label ORDER BY "m".label ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "rare_elements" AS (SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) = 1), "rare_atoms_in_carcinogens" AS (SELECT "a".molecule_id, "a".atom_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "rare_elements" AS "r" ON "r".element = "a".element INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+') SELECT "ra".molecule_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "rare_atoms_in_carcinogens" AS "ra" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "ra".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "ra".atom_id GROUP BY "ra".molecule_id ORDER BY "ra".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "number_of_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "number_of_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'c') AS "number_of_carbon_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') AS "number_of_chlorine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "number_of_carbon_touching_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "number_of_multiple_bonds", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'c') > 0 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "y" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "y".molecule_id = "h".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "h".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "h".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "other" ON ("other".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "other".atom_id = "c".atom_id2) AND "other".atom_id <> "h".atom_id WHERE "y".element = 'y' AND "h".element = 'h' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element AS "element", COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "count_of_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind", COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".molecule_id) DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
